text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning. First, time management is essential: create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so urgent tasks are never forgotten. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish; if a task is too big, reduce it or ask for help. Finally, communication is key. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the last minute. By combining these skills, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more successfully.
